name: Divining Scroll
summary: At Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike gives investigators the Divining Scroll to trace the corrupted elementals to their creator.

sections.title: Tracing Unnatural Elementals
sections.body: Corrupt water elementals rise from Ashenvale’s pools, and the Sentinels know the disturbance is unnatural. Sentinel Velene Starstrike obtains a scroll to find who is responsible. With intact elemental bracers as a focus, its magic draws out the summoner’s signature. The blank parchment becomes a Divined Scroll and names the guilty party.

faq.q: What is the Divining Scroll used for?
faq.answer: The Divining Scroll identifies who created the corrupt water elementals in Ashenvale. Intact elemental bracers focus its magic, which reads the caster’s aura and records their identity.
Sentinel Velene Starstrike gives the scroll to Alliance investigators at Silverwind Refuge in southern Ashenvale as she investigates the tainted waters.

faq.q: Why are intact elemental bracers needed?
faq.answer: Most bracers shatter beyond recognition in combat. A few remain intact, holding enough of their summoner’s binding magic to focus the divination spell.

faq.q: What happens after the scroll is used?
faq.answer: Used in the presence of five intact bracers, the scroll is consumed and becomes a Divined Scroll. It reveals that a rogue mage is deliberately summoning corrupt elementals into the forest’s lakes.

angles.text: The scroll uses divination to track arcane resonance. It reveals that a fellow practitioner is abusing elemental summoning within sacred kaldorei groves.
For the Sentinels who protect Ashenvale, the scroll can expose outsiders who defile the forest’s pristine waters with unnatural corruption.
